notes.title: SPIIIDERS即将到来！警报！警报！
notes.notes:
士兵准备你的霰弹枪。
SPIIIDERS即将到来。
你是世界的最后一次机会。
在不到30个小时内他们来了，所以准备战士！
祝你好运约翰!

notes.title: Countdown SPIIIDERS!
notes.notes:
Countdown toooooo SPIIIDERS day!
Don't forget, the game will be available tomorrow. 21-09-2017
I hope I will see some nice spider hunting videos from you on Youtube.
Sure, you can monetize the videos, btw. the music is Youtube friendly.
So there's no need to turn off the music.

Happy hunting!
